run_proprioception_publisher: run the SpotRosProprioceptionPublisher node to publish robot state, odometry, and gripper trajectory at 10Hz
run_text_to_speech_node: run the text-to-speech ROS node that listens for String messages and speaks them aloud
publish_robot_proprioception: publish robot joint states, xy-yaw position, and gripper transform as a Float32MultiArray ROS message
publish_ee_trajectory_markers: publish end-effector trajectory as red sphere markers in RViz using the MarkerArray visualization
publish_odometry_and_tf: publish odometry messages and static TF transforms from vision frame to body frame
